title: Python sends peer-specific unfragmented SCHC as link broadcast
description: Security review: Node._transmit_peer_schc() accepts a concrete next-hop PeerIdentity, but for packets <= MAX_SINGLE_FRAME_SCHC_PACKET it calls link.send(wrap_schc_payload(schc)) with default AddrMode.NONE instead of the peer canonical EUI-64/Extended mode. Every neighbor therefore authenticates and processes a packet compressed under one peer policy; this leaks unicast traffic, consumes replay/receipt work on non-targets, and contradicts the fragmented path, which correctly uses Extended. Send all peer-policy traffic to iid_to_eui64(peer.iid) with AddrMode.EXTENDED and add an exact wire-destination test for both single-frame and fragmented branches.
